title: Reconciling Universal and Uniform Learning with $Q$-Aggregation
abstract: arXiv:2609.05041v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study regression under bounded responses in terms of excess mean squared error. When the comparator class is finite, this setting is known as model selection aggregation, and achieving minimax excess risk requires improper learning algorithms. Contrary to this, in the universal learning framework no improperness is needed, as simple empirical risk minimization achieves the best-possible exponential learning rate. Hence, the two frameworks suggest different optimal algorithmic principles. This poses the question of best-of-both-worlds guarantees: Are minimax and universal exponential rates achievable by the same algorithm? For finite hypothesis classes, we answer this question in the affirmative by showing that the $Q$-aggregation estimator - which is known to achieve minimax optimal tails - achieves exponential universal rates. translated_title: 基于 $Q$-聚合调和通用学习与一致学习
translated_abstract: 我们在响应有界的条件下，从超额均方误差的角度研究回归问题。当比较类为有限集时，这一设定被称为模型选择聚合，而要达到极小极大超额风险，需要非正常学习算法。与之相反，在通用学习框架中则不需要非正常性，因为简单的经验风险最小化即可达到最优的指数学习速率。因此，这两个框架指向了不同的最优算法原则。由此引出一个“两全其美”的保证问题：极小极大速率与通用指数速率能否由同一个算法同时实现？对于有限假设类，我们对这个问题给出了肯定回答：证明了 $Q$-聚合估计器——已知其能达到极小极大最优尾部——同样能够实现指数级的通用速率。此外，一系列其他估计器和算法原则（ERM、序贯平均、剪枝以及星型……）[摘要在此处截断]
tldr: 本文证明了 $Q$-聚合估计器在有限假设类上能够同时达到极小极大最优速率与指数级通用速率，首次用同一算法统一了通用学习与一致学习（模型选择聚合）两种框架下的最优性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the $Q$-aggregation estimator simultaneously attains minimax optimal rates and exponential universal rates over finite hypothesis classes, reconciling uniform and universal learning within a single algorithm.
